page.overview:
Who is Takuma Hasumi?

Takuma is a teenage male with a slender build and light hair. In contrast, he possesses pitch black narrow eyes said to be perpetually cold. Takuma's distinctive features are a horse-shaped birthmark on his neck and permanent red marks on his arms from having continuously stratched them.

As a high-school student, Takuma wears a dark school uniform, which he does constantly to hide his stratch marks. He also wears a set of three belts on his neck and earrings on his right ear.

Takuma constantly keeps a fountain pen on his chest pocket, a gift from the Crybaby Boy.

Takuma is an aloof and immoral boy burdened by his memories and dedicated to avenging his mother.
